directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: It's so dark here, I can't see a damn thing. Burers all around... Why did I ever agree to do this?! What about you, how did you wind up here?
entries.JA_current: It's so dark here, I can't see a damn thing. Burers all around... Why did I ever agree to do this?! What about you, how did you wind up here?
entries.JA_new: 暗すぎて何も見えねえ。ブーラーがそこらじゅうにいる……こんな仕事、引き受けるんじゃなかった！あんたは？どうしてこんな所にいる？

entries.EN: Keep walking, stalker.
entries.JA_current: 歩き続けろ、ストーカー。
entries.JA_new: 歩き続けろ、ストーカー。

entries.EN: I hate it when someone interrupts when I speak. Anyway, I came here for some important documents. If you've found something, spit it out. If you haven't found anything, get lost and stop wasting my time.
entries.JA_current: 俺が喋ってるのを妨げられのは嫌いなんだ。とにかく、俺はとある重要な記録のために来た。何か知ってるなら打ち明けてくれ、さもなきゃ、面倒なことになるぜ。もし心当たりが無いなら、俺の時間を無駄にしないためにも出て行ってくれ。
entries.JA_new: 人の話に割り込まれるのが大嫌いだ。とにかく、俺は重要な書類を探しに来た。何か見つけたなら、さっさと出せ。何もないなら失せろ。時間の無駄だ。

entries.EN: I hate it when someone interrupts when I speak. Gimme those documents if you don't want to part with your life.
entries.JA_current: 俺が喋ってるのを妨げられのは嫌いなんだ。命が惜しければ、その記録をよこしてくれ。
entries.JA_new: 人の話に割り込まれるのは嫌いだ。命が惜しけりゃ、その書類を渡せ。

entries.EN: I'm on a mission.
entries.JA_current: 作戦中だ。
entries.JA_new: 任務中だ。

entries.EN: I don't even know how I wound up here. I'd love to be off as soon as possible.
entries.JA_current: I don't even know how I wound up here. I'd love to be off as soon as possible.
entries.JA_new: どうしてここに来たのかも分からない。できるだけ早くここを出たい。

entries.EN: Be good.
entries.JA_current: Be good.
entries.JA_new: じゃあな。

entries.EN: You're laughable, man! This conversation is over. Get out of my way.
entries.JA_current: おしゃべりは終わりだ。さぁ、行ってくれ。
entries.JA_new: 笑わせるな。話は終わりだ。邪魔だからどけ。

entries.EN: Well... I've come across some info, but it doesn't seem to be anything interesting.
entries.JA_current: Well... I've come across some info, but it doesn't seem to be anything interesting.
entries.JA_new: いや……情報なら少し見つけたが、大したものじゃなさそうだ。

entries.EN: No, I don't have any documents. All I want is to get outta here.
entries.JA_current: I don't have any documents.
entries.JA_new: いや、書類は持ってない。ここから出たいだけだ。

entries.EN: Take it easy, man. Here's the docs for you, take them. They aren't that important after all...
entries.JA_current: Take it easy, man. Here's the docs for you, take them. They aren't that important after all...
entries.JA_new: 分かった、落ち着け。これが書類だ、持ってけよ。たいしたものじゃないからさ……

entries.EN: Hmm. What kind of mission? Are you looking for something? Or have you found it already? I've heard there's lots of goodies in here...
entries.JA_current: フム。どんな作戦だい？ 何かを探しているのか？ あるいは、既に見つけたのか？ 俺はこの辺りに素晴らしい物があると聞いたことがあるんだ。
entries.JA_new: ふむ。どんな任務だ？何か探してるのか？それとも、もう見つけた？ここにはお宝がたくさんあると聞いてるぞ……

entries.EN: You haven't found anything worthwhile here, have you? They say there's some information about scientific experiments down here. They're worth some good money...
entries.JA_current: You haven't found anything worthwhile here, have you? They say there's some information about scientific experiments. They're worth some good money...
entries.JA_new: ここで何か使えるものは見つかったか？地下には科学実験に関する情報があるらしい。かなりの金になるそうだ……

entries.EN: Uh-huh, sod off now... I got one last advice for you - watch your step, stalker, you'll need it!
entries.JA_current: Uh-huh, sod off now... I got one last advice for you - watch your step, stalker, you'll need it!
entries.JA_new: ああ、もう失せろ。最後にひとつ忠告だ。足元に気をつけな、ストーカー。必要になるぞ！

entries.EN: That's much better, chum. Now give me all the information you've got, every little thing to the last scrap of paper. And don't even think of pulling anything funny 'cause that joke would be your last...
entries.JA_current: That's much better, chum. Now give me all the information you've got, every little thing to the last scrap of paper. And don't even think of pulling anything funny 'cause that joke would be your last...
entries.JA_new: そいつはいい。聞いたことを全部、紙切れ1枚まで出せ。妙な真似をしたら最後だぞ……

entries.EN: Alright then, off you go. If you find something - I'll be around...
entries.JA_current: Alright then, off you go. If you find something - I'll be around...
entries.JA_new: 分かった。行っていい。何か見つけたら、また会おう……

entries.EN: I'm sorry, I can't tell you and I don't have the time anyway.
entries.JA_current: すまない。あなたには話せないし、時間も無いんだ。
entries.JA_new: 悪いが話せない。それに今は時間がない。

entries.EN: No, I haven't found anything.
entries.JA_current: いいや、何も見つけちゃいない。
entries.JA_new: いや、何も見つけてない。

entries.EN: No, I haven't.
entries.JA_current: No, I haven't.
entries.JA_new: いや、まだだ。

entries.EN: To hell with all that information. I'm barely staying alive in here.
entries.JA_current: To hell with all that information. I'm barely staying alive in here.
entries.JA_new: 情報なんてどうでもいい。ここで生き延びるだけで精一杯だ。

entries.EN: Be good.
entries.JA_current: 覚えておくよ。
entries.JA_new: じゃあな。

entries.EN: Wait up, don't run yet. You'll have enough opportunities for that... What did you find? Myself, I'm not hanging around here for nothing, you know.
entries.JA_current: Wait up, don't run yet. You'll have enough opportunities for that... What did you find? Myself, I'm not hanging around here for nothing, you know.
entries.JA_new: 待て、まだ行くな。逃げる機会ならいくらでもある……何を見つけた？俺だって理由もなくこんな所にいるわけじゃない。

entries.EN: Yeah?.. And what if you think really well about it? Are you hiding something from me?
entries.JA_current: Yeah?.. And what if you think really well about it? Are you hiding something from me?
entries.JA_new: そうか？……よく考え直してみろ。何か隠してないか？

entries.EN: What I found is my business.
entries.JA_current: 俺が見つけたのは俺のものだ。
entries.JA_new: 見つけた物は俺の勝手だ。

entries.EN: I found some documents. The Barkeep wants them.
entries.JA_current: X18 から文書を見つけてきた。Barkeep はそれに良い報酬を約束してくれたんだ。
entries.JA_new: 書類を見つけた。バーキープが欲しがってる。

entries.EN: No, I'm telling you frankly.
entries.JA_current: いいや。
entries.JA_new: いや、正直に話してる。

entries.EN: What kind of question is that? We're in the Zone, not some marketplace.
entries.JA_current: どんな質問だ？
entries.JA_new: 何の質問だよ？ここはゾーンだ、商店街じゃない。

entries.EN: Are you threatening me?
entries.JA_current: 私を脅しているのか？
entries.JA_new: 脅してるのか？

entries.EN: I'm telling you, stop! I'm not roaming around this rat hole for nothing. Stop horsing around and tell me what you've found. We could even split it...
entries.JA_current: I'm telling you, stop! I'm not roaming around this rat hole for nothing. Stop horsing around and tell me what you've found. We could even split it...
entries.JA_new: 言っただろ、止まれ！俺はこんなネズミ穴を理由もなくうろついてるんじゃない。ふざけるのはやめて、何を見つけたか話せ。一緒に分ける手もあるぞ……

entries.EN: Documents, eh... Just so you know, that's exactly what I came here for. And now you will hand them over and be on your way. Understood?
entries.JA_current: Documents, huh... Just so you know, that's exactly what I came here for. And now you will hand them over and get on your way. Understood?
entries.JA_new: 書類か……ちょうど俺が探してたものだ。渡してもらうぞ。渡したら立ち去れ。分かったな？

entries.EN: Listen, pal, I've made it through fire, anomalies and monsters in this stinking Zone and as you can see I'm still alive! So don't you tell me what I can or cannot say. I've come here for the documents and I won't leave without them. If they're on you, I advise you to hand them over or this hole will be your grave! Got it?
entries.JA_current: Listen, pal, I've made it through fire, anomalies and monsters in this stinking Zone and as you can see I'm still alive! So don't you tell me what I can or cannot say. I've come here for the documents and I won't leave without them. If they're on you, I advise you to hand them over or rest in peace in this hole! Got it?
entries.JA_new: 聞けよ、相棒。俺はこの臭いゾーンで、火の中もアノマリーも怪物もくぐり抜けて、今もこうして生きてる！何を話すかは俺が決める。俺は書類を探しに来た。手ぶらで帰る気はない。お前が持ってるなら、渡した方がいい。さもないと、この穴がお前の墓場になるぞ！分かったか？

entries.EN: What the hell?.. I'm not sharing anything. You need something - you go and search yourself.
entries.JA_current: 私は何も共有していない。
entries.JA_new: 何だよ……分ける気はない。欲しけりゃ自分で探せ。

entries.EN: Are you threatening me? I have several very convincing arguments, fully locked and loaded in this piece of hardware right here!
entries.JA_current: 私を脅しているのか？
entries.JA_new: 脅しか？この銃には、弾がたっぷり詰まった、かなり説得力のある返事が用意してあるぞ！

entries.EN: Got it.
entries.JA_current: Got it.
entries.JA_new: 分かった。

entries.EN: Take it easy, man. I told you I hadn't found anything. Wanna search my pockets?!
entries.JA_current: Take it easy, man. I told you I hadn't found anything. Wanna search my pockets?!
entries.JA_new: 落ち着けよ。何も見つけてないって言ったろ。ポケットまで探るか？

entries.EN: OK, OK, cool it... Soon as I get curious, you're grabbing your gun! No more questions. Just be careful, that's all.
entries.JA_current: OK, OK, cool it... Soon as I get curious, you're grabbing your gun! No more questions. Just be careful, that's all.
entries.JA_new: 分かった分かった、落ち着けよ……好奇心で聞いただけなのに、すぐ銃を抜くんだな！もう聞かない。気をつけろ、それだけだ。

entries.EN: If you're lying to me, you're in deep shit. If you are thinking of screwing me, you're in deep shit, and if you try to shove me some crap, you're in deep shit. In fact, you're so deep in shit that you'll have to swim very hard to keep afloat! Now, let me try one more time in case you're deaf or slow: have you found the documents?
entries.JA_current: If you're lying to me, you're in deep shit. If you've are thinking of screwing me, you're in deep shit, and if you try to shove me some crap, you're in deep shit. In fact, you're so deep in shit that you'll have to swim very hard to keep afloat! Now, let me try one more time for the idiots in the assistance: have you found the documents?
entries.JA_new: 嘘をついても、俺を裏切っても、ガラクタを押しつけようとしても、ただじゃ済まないぞ。お前はもう泥沼の底だ。必死で泳がないと沈むぞ！耳が悪いのか、頭が鈍いのか……最後にもう一度聞く。書類は見つかったのか？

entries.EN: Alright then, but next time, watch your mouth. You may go now. In case you find something, I'll be around...
entries.JA_current: Alrighty, and next time, watch your mouth. You may go now. In case you find something, I'll be around...
entries.JA_new: 分かった。だが次は口の利き方に気をつけろ。もう行け。何か見つけたら、また会うだろう……

entries.EN: Look, man, stop screwing with my brain. Let's make a deal. I'll give you a nice chunk of money - you won't be sorry.
entries.JA_current: Look, man, stop screwing with my brain. Let's make a deal. I'll give you a nice chunk of money - you won't be sorry.
entries.JA_new: なあ、俺をからかうのはやめろ。取引しよう。かなりの金を払う。後悔はさせない。

entries.EN: I'll offer something.
entries.JA_current: 何か提供しよう。
entries.JA_new: 金を払う。

entries.EN: Listen, my life depends on these documents. Let's see what you got - I think we can come to an agreement...
entries.JA_current: 聞いてくれ、俺の命はこの記録にかかってるんだ。あんたが手に入れたものを見せてくれ。俺たちは契約できると思うんだ…。
entries.JA_new: 聞いてくれ。この書類に俺の命がかかってる。何を見つけたか話せ。条件は合わせられると思う……
